The core rule is: the AI never gets delete permissions. It can only propose a fix and wait for human approval. To prove content survives, I run a simple regression: seed a known post > trigger a fix scenario > verify the post is still there and unchanged. It’s not a theoretical rule, it’s enforced both in the prompt and at the database level. Still early, but so far zero incidents.
